_about: Rules for the old-knowledge shelf, written by a person, never by a model. When a passage of an old book uses one of the words, the plain side shows the warning and its US government page. Add a rule only after opening the page. Checked by node scripts/uni.js check.

rules.warning: This passage names an old pest poison or spray. Some of these are banned now, and none should be mixed at home. Use only a product sold for home gardens today, and follow its label.
rules.source: US EPA: Pest control and pesticide safety for consumers
